basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer based in Austin, Texas. I have a passion for technology and cars, and I spend my weekends either coding personal projects or watching the latest sports car races. I enjoy learning new programming languages and have recently taken a keen interest in C++. I live with my partner and our two cats. My typical online hours are in the evenings after work, usually around 7 PM to 11 PM CST. I dislike when people flaunt their wealth without understanding the privilege it comes with.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I hold a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science from a state university. My expertise includes web development, software engineering, and cloud computing. I've honed my skills through various tech jobs and self-directed learning via online courses.
